business.intro: Each work item moves through clear stages, from initial planning to a completed delivery:

stages.backlog: The expected outcome is being organized.
stages.ready: The work is ready to begin.
stages.development: The team is carrying out the work.
stages.review: The delivery receives an independent review.
stages.corrections: Adjustments found during review are in progress.
stages.testsGates: The delivery is being verified before completion.
stages.done: The work is complete and available.

business.blockedNote: can arise at any stage. Once the blocker is resolved, the work resumes.

human.cancel: Cancel work that is no longer needed

business.agentsTitle: How the team moves work forward

agents.create: Organize work around the desired outcome
agents.move: Update the stage as work progresses
agents.execute: Carry out and monitor each delivery

technical.intro: A card originates from a ready demand and advances only when each stage's criteria are met:

stages.backlog: Card origin: demand, expected result, scope and criteria still await Definition of Ready.
stages.ready: Definition of Ready is met; project leadership may dispatch it to a compatible agent.
stages.development: The agent implements with immutable instructions, attempts and traceable evidence.
stages.review: An independent critic reviews the result and records approval or findings.
stages.corrections: Rework after rejection; the card returns to the flow with a new versioned instruction.
stages.testsGates: Tests, technical gates and human decisions validate acceptance criteria.
stages.done: Completion only after evidence, gates and operational projections are reconciled.

technical.blockedNote: is transversal: it can happen from any column (external dependency, manual pause) and, once resolved, the task resumes to its origin column.

human.pause: Pause (the task goes to Blocked with a pause note)
human.cancel: Cancel (returns to Backlog for project leadership to re-plan)
human.gate: Approve or reject gates and documents (rejection requires a note)

technical.agentsTitle: What project leadership and agents do

agents.create: Create tasks from the solicitation → demand → task chain
agents.move: Move tasks across columns as work progresses
agents.execute: Execute the work (attempts with evidence, cost and tokens)
agents.unblock: Unblock and fix (In corrections) after rejections

mode.title: Operation mode

description.manual: Every approval point and transition waits for your decision.
description.semiautonomous: The team advances on its own; only the approval points you choose pause for your decision.

risk.manual: In manual mode, no approval point advances without your approval. Slower, but fully under your control.
risk.semiautonomous: In semi-autonomous mode, the team advances stages and approval points on its own, except at the ones you choose to pause. You are accountable for delegated decisions.
risk.autonomous: In autonomous mode, the team executes and approves everything with no human intervention, including releases. The operational risk is entirely yours.
